crossRefs.note: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!
Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;
How much less man, who is a worm, the son of man, who is a worm!”
Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.
“Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.
Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.
We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.
But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less…
When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;
what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the…
who brings princes to nothing, who makes the judges of the earth meaningless.
“For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
Yes, can any understand the spreading of the clouds, and the thunderings of his pavilion?
Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?
Yahweh is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. Yahweh has his way in…

translations.web: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.
translations.bsb: Look to the heavens and see; gaze at the clouds high above you.
translations.kjv: Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds which are higher
translations.asv: Look unto the heavens, and see; And behold the skies, which are higher than thou.
